description: This file defines interfaces related to warning reporting, including warning events, reporting units, and control mechanisms within the WPEFramework. It declares abstract classes and control structures for handling warning events and categories.

classes.name: IWarningEvent
classes.description: Interface for warning event objects, providing methods for serialization, deserialization, categorization, and warning identification.

classes.name: IWarningReportingUnit
classes.description: Interface for warning reporting units, managing warning events and category controls.

classes.name: IWarningReportingUnit::IWarningReportingControl
classes.description: Control interface for warning categories, allowing exclusion, configuration, and cloning of warning category controls.

methods.name: IWarningEvent::~IWarningEvent
methods.description: Destructor for the warning event interface.

methods.name: IWarningEvent::Category
methods.description: Returns the category of the warning event.

methods.name: IWarningEvent::Serialize
methods.description: Serializes the warning event into a byte array.

methods.name: IWarningEvent::Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes the warning event from a byte array.

methods.name: IWarningEvent::ToString
methods.description: Converts the warning event to a string representation.

methods.name: IWarningEvent::IsWarning
methods.description: Indicates whether the event is a warning.

methods.name: IWarningReportingUnit::~IWarningReportingUnit
methods.description: Destructor for the warning reporting unit interface.

methods.name: IWarningReportingUnit::ReportWarningEvent
methods.description: Reports a warning event with an identifier.

methods.name: IWarningReportingUnit::FetchCategoryInformation
methods.description: Fetches information about a specific warning category.

methods.name: IWarningReportingUnit::AddToCategoryList
methods.description: Adds a category control to the category list.

methods.name: IWarningReportingUnit::RemoveFromCategoryList
methods.description: Removes a category control from the category list.

methods.name: IWarningReportingUnit::IWarningReportingControl::Configure
methods.description: Configures a category with specific settings.
